mapper.select: select sys_id , table_name , table_num , table_qty , x_coordinate , y_coordinate , height , width , table_type from table_info si where 1=1 and exists ( select 1 from qr_code qc where 1=1 and qc.link_sys_id = si.sys_id ) and si.plant_cd = #{sysPlantCd} and delete_yn = 'N' and use_yn = 'Y' order by table_num asc
